text: Third time I've tried to get through. I mind a little girl, 7, her mum's not picking up. She's 39 degrees. She's not been for a poo in three days and she's been moaning about her tummy being full. Her skin is very dark so I couldn't see much on her body, but I checked her palms and the soles of her feet and pulled down her bottom eyelid. There are tiny dark dots on her palms and a few inside the eyelid. I pressed the side of a glass on her hand and I could still see them through it, they didn't go away. Can someone please tell me what to do.
